name: helpdesk
$comment: Phase 6 wire shape: _action carries {name} only. Cross-controller fixture (Requester creates tickets; Agent acts on them via shared SQLite DB). The wire shape change moved every form-input value into a state slot — fixture steps that simulate a 'user typed → user clicked' interaction set those slots via stateMutations. Per-tab actions (filter-${value}, set-type-${value}, set-priority-${value}) carry the value in the action name AND the TabsNode bind writes it to state; the agent's filter handler is a pure no-op (bind alone is enough) while the requester's set-type handler clears validationError as a side effect. Per-row select-ticket-${id} reads the id from the action name; singular page-level actions (start-ticket / resolve-ticket / save-notes) read state.selectedTicketId. Bulk actions read state.bulkSelection — the VISIBLE-scoped harvest sink that TableNode.selection's buttons write (the currently-checked, currently-rendered row ids); the fixture has no DOM so it writes that array via stateMutations before each bulk dispatch, exactly what the harvest would have written.

steps.$comment: Phase 33: titleFilter (string) → titleFilterDescriptor (FilterDescriptor object). Wire migration.
Phase 33: clear = empty rules[]; joiner still present for wire-shape.
3.8.0 — matching X-VMS-Client-Build header passes; response carries serverBuild (both backends stamp identically).
3.8.0 — mismatched header → 400 ok:false stale_client, rejected BEFORE _state is deserialized. Message wording differs per backend so it's ignored; errors.0.code (stale_client) is diffed.

9.0.0 (SKEW-07) — GET with MATCHING X-VMS-Client-Build header passes; response is the normal ok:true render with serverBuild stamped. The expectBodyContains substring 'serverBuild:helpdesk-build-1' is the coverage tripwire (AGENTS.md gotcha #9): if the parity/run.ts GET-branch header hoist regresses (silently vacuuming the header away), the backends still return an ok:true render, but this branch was meant to prove the header ROUND-TRIPPED — pair with the mismatched-header step below which proves the 400 branch fires. Both together prove the harness's new GET-header hoist actually sends the header.

9.0.0 (SKEW-07) — GET with MISMATCHED X-VMS-Client-Build header → 400 stale_client. This is the branch the pre-9.0.0 fixture COULD NOT REACH (GETs bypassed the guard entirely on both backends: the .NET side had no global filter, only per-controller Parse(HttpRequest, currentBuild) which never runs on GETs; the bun side had no createVersionGuard wrap around the GET route). Now .NET ShellVersionGuardFilter (Plan 29-02, self-registered by AddVmsShellVersioning) and bun createVersionGuard (Plan 29-04, wrapped around agent GET in Task 2) both fail-close. The expectBodyContains 'stale_client' is the coverage tripwire (AGENTS.md gotcha #9): if either backend regresses the GET-guard, the response body would NOT contain 'stale_client' and this step FAILS LOUDLY. Message wording differs per backend (StaleClientException vs the TS factory's hand-formatted string) — errors.0.message is diffed-ignored; errors.0.code (stale_client) is diffed.
